title: Studio action form: add a row for the action's translatable texts (ActionSchema.texts, from PR #35085 / #34374)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-G, mailbox #32588, 6967686326, item 1). It is a follow-up owed before PR #35085 closes #34374.

PR #35085 adds `ActionSchema.texts`: an action's own translatable sentences, resolved in the organization's locale. The Studio action property form has **no row** for `texts` (an omit row today), so an admin cannot author them without editing metadata by hand.

Done when the action form edits `texts` (add, edit and remove keys, with the authoring-language value), with a pin, and the omit row is removed.

Grade: **p2 · domain:ui**. Theme: zh-CN customers (action texts show in the organization's language). It completes a new capability; nothing is broken, so p2. Routed to seat 4; seat 3 is winding down.

Blocked-by: #35085
